name: Qentrox Bulk Variation Grid for WooCommerce
author: arhamashfaq

sections.description:
Qentrox Bulk Variation Grid for WooCommerce replaces the default variable product dropdowns with a quantity list interface. This allows customers to input quantities for multiple variations simultaneously and add them to the cart in a single action.

Built for efficiency, this plugin uses an AJAX-based processing system to handle bulk variations efficiently even on standard hosting environments.

Core Features

  • Quantity List Interface: Unpacks variations into a table-style quantity interface.
  • Bulk Add-To-Cart: Users can input quantities for multiple variations and add them all with one button click.
  • AJAX Processing: Optimizes the add-to-cart process for better performance.
  • Stock Integration: Respects WooCommerce stock status and inventory levels.

B2B Efficiency

This grid interface is designed to reduce the number of clicks required to purchase variable products. By providing a layout where all options are visible at once, it streamlines the procurement process for high-volume buyers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the qentrox-bulk-variation-grid-for-woocommerce directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Variable products will now automatically display the bulk quantity list on their single product pages.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Simple Products?

No, this plugin focuses on variable product types.

Can I customize the layout?

The free version provides a standardized list layout. Advanced layouts and customization options are available in the separate Pro version.

  • Implemented bulk AJAX add-to-cart functionality for variable products.
